member.inviteHelp: {who} creates a SoisFier account, then chooses “Join a family” and enters this code. It is valid for 48 hours. Rights: {role}.
member.removeText: This person will no longer have access to the family. The history of their approvals is kept.
member.shareText: Join our family on SoisFier with the code {code}: {url}

parent.startText: Add your first child. You can then choose their routines from templates.

child.privacy: Only the first name is stored. No surname or date of birth.
child.delText: Their routines, stars and history will be permanently erased.

routine.none: {name} has no routines yet. The templates cover morning, lunchtime and evening: tick three or four to get started.
routine.bonusHelp: Bonus routine: optional, it earns stars without counting towards the day
routine.alreadyValidated: Routine already approved. To take stars away, use a broken star (Penalties tab).
routine.delText: It disappears from upcoming days. Stars already earned are kept.
